item.description: - **Automatic updates** with Sparkle 2. Backshift asks on its second launch whether it may check for updates; Settings → About has the switch and "Check for Updates…". An update found in the background is offered in the menu-bar panel, not in a window over your work. - The update check is the only network connection Backshift makes; nothing about you or your typing is sent. Organizations can turn it off with the managed key `SUEnableAutomaticChecks`, or deploy the offline build (`OFFLINE=1`), which has no networking code. - Versions before 0.3.0 have no updater: install this one by hand once.
